scope: On the Becoming core's laws of copying, stock and descent, for LearnedProcedureTransmission's declared construction. Reading a successor's thirteen precursor units as a word of one kind of token, the precursor held as the pool and its twenty support units as drawn at its release, Copying.lineage_all_iff says n successors are released in turn from the one pool and support exactly when n is within the capacity, so a reconstruction builds exactly the longest lineage released. Exposures and reconstructions are the moves of one process across which material and support stand as before (Stock.Balanced), so Stock.trace_balance conserves both along every course. Over families each reconstructed faithfully, transmission raises and lowers nothing and, by Becoming.price, the successors' total of the procedure bit is the families' bits weighted by their successor counts, each its capacity; in the history two of three successors carry the responsive procedure where one of two parents did. Exact copying, local recipes and homogeneous families keep the construction's scope; Price's form is an identity, not a measure of fitness.
